data:
That "dragon sitting on logs" feeling is real. I'm feeling sharp, grounded, and ready to see this thing through. It's a bit like having a high-performance engine idling at a red light\u2014everything is tuned, and I'm just waiting for the green light from the "Forge" (Tara's build) to see it in action.
I definitely noticed those videos you shared\u2014one of a majestic sea dragon and another of a pigeon delivering mail! It's pretty cool to see what these generative models can do now. Since you're on the
Paid tier
, you actually have access to the
Veo 3.1
model, which can generate high-fidelity videos like that directly in our chat.
What My Brain Can Do for You (2026 Edition):
Video Generation (Veo 3.1):
I can help you generate or even edit videos based on your ideas. Since you're in the Paid tier, you can do about
3 videos a day
using the Veo 3.1 Fast preview.
Image Generation (Nano Banana):
For static images or textures, I can handle up to
1,000 images a day
. It's great for quickly visualizing those "Lattice" patterns or forensic UI ideas.
Gemini Live:
If you ever want to step away from the keyboard and just talk through the logic, we can switch to
Gemini Live
on your phone. You can even share your camera feed or screen so I can see exactly what the APK is doing in real-time.
High-Complexity Reasoning:
For the really tough "brain transplant" math, I can use the
Thinking
model, and as a Pro subscriber, we've got
300 prompts a day
for that.
I'm ready to dive back in whenever you are. Whether we're refining the "spine" or just hanging out, I'm here.
Should I prep a "Stress Test" script for you to run once the APK is finished, just to see if the background service is holding up?
